authForm.tagline: Access the world of OpenSource security: Simplified, Streamlined, Accessible.

signIn.accountDisabled: Your session ended because your account was disabled.
signIn.genericError: An error occurred. Please try again later.

backupCodes.generated: Backup codes generated. Save them — they are shown only once.
backupCodes.fileFooter: Keep these codes safe. Each code can only be used once.

changePassword.title: Change Password
changePassword.description: Update your account password to keep your profile secure.
changePassword.sameAsCurrent: Choose a password different from the current one
changePassword.authRequired: Authentication required. Please log in again.

forcedChange.title: Choose a new password
forcedChange.intro: Your password was set by your security team, so they know it too.
forcedChange.chooseFor: Choose your own for {username} to continue.

totp.title: Two-Factor Authentication (TOTP)
totp.intro: Add an extra layer of security to your account. You will need an authenticator app like Google Authenticator, Authy, or Microsoft Authenticator.
totp.scanPrompt: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app:
totp.clockWarning: Make sure your device clock is accurate. TOTP codes are time-sensitive and allow only a ±30 second tolerance window.
totp.verifyPrompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to confirm:
totp.active: Two-factor authentication is active. You will be asked for a code from your authenticator app every time you log in.
totp.disableConfirm: Are you sure you want to disable two-factor authentication?
totp.disablePrompt: Enter your TOTP code or a backup code to disable 2FA:
totp.regeneratePrompt: Enter your TOTP code to generate new backup codes. Old codes will be invalidated.
